newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo firms sack 205 between Sept 16-Sept 21.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo firms sack 205 between Sept 16-Sept 21.

text.p: Private firms located in Sao Paulo state laid off 205 employees between Sept 16 and Sept 21, a spokesman for the Sao Paulo State Industries Federation (Fiesp) said.
In the previous week, Sao Paulo's industries sacked 2,214 workers.
Seven out of the 46 sectors included in the survey hired new workers and 14 sacked personnel in the period. Twenty-five maintained their staff unchanged, he said.
So far this year, Sao Paulo industries have laid off 150,485 workers or 6.99 percent of Sao Paulo's industrial workforce, the spokesman said.
In the last 12 months, Sao Paulo firms have sacked 236,774 workers, or 10.56 percent of Sao Paulo's industrial workforce, he added.
